description: Versioned semantic contract for structured Oireachtas query plans. Plans describe the user's requested meaning, not executable SPARQL.

compatibility.schemaVersion: The consumer supports plan schema version 1 and rejects other schema versions.
compatibility.compatibleChanges: Additive optional fields and additive reviewed supported entity types, semantic facts, or filter fields may remain within contract major version 1 when existing meanings and validation semantics are unchanged. Consumers ignore unknown optional fields and reject unsupported semantic vocabulary values.
compatibility.breakingChanges: After this controlled semantic vocabulary is established, changing an existing field's meaning, required semantics, supported resolution states, or validation expectations, including removing or reinterpreting a supported semantic identifier, requires a contract major version bump.
compatibility.consumerSupport: Consumers reject unsupported schema versions, contract major versions, and semantic vocabulary values. A newer minor or patch version within major 1 is compatible when it uses only supported semantic states.

scope.purpose: Capture intent, referenced entities, requested facts and relations, filters, temporal meaning, aggregation, and answer shape before query generation.
notIncluded: named graph identifiers or graph patterns

planSemantics.conjunction: Every requirement, filter, and temporal constraint in one plan applies conjunctively.
planSemantics.participantIdentity: Entity participants with the same entity id refer to the same entity. Type-only participants of the same type refer to one semantic result role throughout the plan; separate unbound roles of the same type are not represented in schema version 1.
planSemantics.resolutionReadiness: Ambiguous and unresolved entities are valid semantic plan states but are not executable identity bindings. Consumers must clarify or resolve them and must not select a candidate arbitrarily or drop a dependent constraint.
planSemantics.filterMeaning: Filter fields are controlled semantic identifiers supported only for the facts listed in semanticVocabulary. Operators and typed values express semantic constraints, not SPARQL FILTER syntax or label-matching heuristics. Equality means semantic equality; no fuzzy matching is implied.
planSemantics.unknownExtensions: Consumers may ignore unknown optional fields for compatible major-version extensions and must not treat them as SPARQL, graph, variable, endpoint, or source-selection instructions.
planSemantics.iriValidation: The contract checks the local Oireachtas IRI namespace but does not manufacture identifiers or independently verify the resolver's entity-type-to-IRI assignment.
